mistralai/devstral-small-2505.reason: Mistral/All Hands AI's Devstral Small 2505 (Hugging Face repo created 2025-05-12, fine-tuned from Mistral-Small-3.1); the index has only the later devstral-small-2507 and Small 2 checkpoints, so defer rather than link the wrong Devstral.

moonshotai/kimi-k3.reason: Kimi K3 (moonshotai/Kimi-K3 on Hugging Face, 2.8T MoE, 1M context, launched 2026-07-16) matches moonshot/kimi-k3; NanoGPT's 0.45/9.6 price is a discount off the model's median.

openai/gpt-6-astra-pro.reason: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra Pro is the same underlying model as GPT-6 Astra served with reasoning.mode set to pro (per OpenRouter's listing); a pro reasoning-mode serving is still openai/gpt-6-astra at the 10/50 pro rate.

openai/gpt-6-luna-pro.reason: GPT-6 Luna Pro is the same underlying model as GPT-6 Luna with reasoning.mode set to pro (per OpenRouter's listing); a pro reasoning-mode serving is still openai/gpt-6-luna at the 0.1/0.5 pro rate.

openai/gpt-6-sol-pro.reason: GPT-6 Sol Pro is the same underlying model as GPT-6 Sol with reasoning.mode set to pro (per OpenRouter's listing); a pro reasoning-mode serving is still openai/gpt-6-sol at the 2/10 pro rate.

pqhaz/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-heretic.reason: pqhaz's Heretic checkpoint applies a directional ablation of refusal behaviour to the weights of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (per its Hugging Face card); a weight-edited derivative is not deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 itself.

pqhaz/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-heretic:t.reason: The :thinking suffix is the thinking-mode serving of pqhaz's Heretic checkpoint, which directionally ablates refusal behaviour in the weights of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017; a weight-edited derivative is not deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 itself.

sicariussicariistuff/assistant-pepe-32b.reason: SicariusSicariiStuff's Assistant Pepe 32B is a community fine-tune of Qwen3-32B for creative writing and roleplay; a fine-tune is not the Qwen base model, and the index has no entry for it or its creator.

soob3123/amoral-gemma3-27B-v2.reason: Hugging Face metadata lists soob3123/amoral-gemma3-27B-v2 as a fine-tune of google/gemma-3-27b-it (a community 'amoral' variant, Apr 2025); a fine-tune is not the Gemma base model and the index has no entry for it.

speakleash/bielik-11b-v3.0-instruct.reason: Speakleash/ACK Cyfronet's Bielik 11B v3.0 Instruct (Hugging Face, Apache 2.0, Nov 2025), an instruct tune of their own Bielik v3 base; a real chat model the index does not contain.

unsloth/gemma-3-12b-it.reason: unsloth/gemma-3-12b-it is Unsloth's mirror of Google's Gemma 3 12B IT instruction-tuned checkpoint (image-text-to-text, released 2025-03-12); same model as google/gemma-3-12b-it, and NanoGPT's flat 0.272 rate is above the model's median.

xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro-ultraspeed.reason: MiMo-V2.6-Pro-UltraSpeed is Xiaomi's fast-serving tier of the same 1T MiMo-V2.6-Pro checkpoint (same quality, ~10x output speed); still xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro at the 4.35/8.7 speed-tier price.

xtools-at/deepseek-v4-pro-qwen3.5-9b-unc.reason: xtools-at's uncensored Heretic build, listed on Hugging Face as a finetune of Jackrong/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B, itself a Qwen3.5 9B distill of DeepSeek V4 Pro; a derivative of a distill is not any catalog model, and the index has no entry.

z-ai/GLM-4.6-turbo.reason: NanoGPT's page: a fast variant of GLM 4.6 for general chat, coding and analysis with improved latency — same 204.8K context as GLM-4.6 with speed-tier pricing (0.55/2.2), like Z.ai's AirX speed tiers; still zhipu/glm-4.6.

z-ai/GLM-4.6-turbo:thinking.reason: The :thinking suffix is thinking-mode serving of GLM 4.6 Turbo, itself the fast tier of the GLM-4.6 checkpoint (same 204.8K context); a thinking/fast serving is still zhipu/glm-4.6.

z-ai/glm-5.3-flash-apex.reason: Apex Flash 1 is Cantina Security and Yeta Labs' cybersecurity post-train of Z.ai's GLM-5.3-Flash (GRPO with rank-256 LoRA plus selective full-parameter training, per their release); a fine-tune is not zhipu/glm-5.3-flash itself.

z-ai/glm-5.3-flash-apex-abliterated.reason: An abliterated derivative of Cantina/Yeta's Apex Flash 1 — itself a GLM-5.3-Flash post-train — with refusal behavior modified in the weights (per Modeldex); a weight-edited derivative is not zhipu/glm-5.3-flash itself.

z-ai/glm-5.3-flash-cybersecurity.reason: Listings describe a cybersecurity-tuned variant whose base model is GLM-5.3 Flash, attributed to Z.ai (Sep 2026); sources conflict on whether the weights differ from stock, and the index has no entry for it, so defer.

z-ai/glm-5.3-flash-uncensored.reason: dealignai's uncensored build of GLM-5.3-Flash with refusal behavior removed directly in the weights, vision input kept (per Heabsy/Infron listings); a weight-edited derivative is not zhipu/glm-5.3-flash itself.

z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx-legal.reason: Z.ai's GLM-Legal (GLM-5.3-FlashX-Legal), the legal-domain mid/post-training variant of GLM-5.3-FlashX listed Nov 2, 2026 (per OpenRouter/i-scoop); the index has no GLM-Legal or FlashX entry, so defer.

z-ai/glm-5.3-uncensored.reason: dealignai/Arnict's GLM 5.3 Abliterated — the full 753B GLM-5.3 with refusal behavior removed directly in the weights (per Infron/Heabsy listings); a weight-edited derivative is not zhipu/glm-5.3 itself.
